prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — it depends on your goals, budget, industry, and which services you need (SEO, PPC, social, content, web design, e‑commerce, etc.). I can help you find the best fit. A few quick questions will let me give a targeted recommendation:

1. What are your main goals? (lead generation, e‑commerce sales, brand awareness, local traffic, app installs, etc.)
2. Which services do you need? (SEO, Google Ads, Facebook/Instagram, content, email, web development, analytics)
3. What’s your monthly/annual marketing budget?
4. Do you have a timeline or geographic focus (local St. Louis customers vs. national)?
5. Any industry specifics or past agency experiences to note?

If you prefer to research on your own, use these criteria to evaluate agencies:
- Relevant case studies and measurable results for businesses like yours
- Client testimonials and third‑party reviews (Clutch, Google, Facebook)
- Clear reporting and KPIs (how they measure success)
- Team expertise and in‑house capabilities vs. outsourcing
- Pricing model and contract flexibility
- Cultural fit and communication style

If you want, I can:
- Recommend a short list of highly rated St. Louis agencies matched to your needs
- Compare 3–5 agencies on pricing, services, case studies, and pros/cons
- Draft an RFP/email to send to agencies to get proposals

Which option would you like?
